body:
This is what I was afraid of :(

This should be this timeout that needs to be increase: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/master/integration-tests/logging-gelf/src/test/java/io/quarkus/logging/gelf/it/GelfLogHandlerTest.java#L51

Ideally we should switch to a more "clever" think than awaiting, I need to check but there should be some API that we can request to know if the UDP input is ready.

As a temporal solution, the wait can be increase to 10s, on my local computer 2s was enought.

issue.title: Increase UDP input readiness wait time
Attempt to fix Graylog CI issues

labels.name: triage/waiting-for-ci
labels.description: Ready to merge when CI successfully finishes

issue.body:
Fixes #13364

I was able to reproduce the CI error locally, by using `<cpu>1<cpus>` in the elasticsearch container configuration.
By then switching to:

```
<cpus>2</cpus>
<cpuShares>2048</cpuShares>
```

the problem went away
